title: Data model for an EVOP biomass inventory
description: CIRCULOOS data model for the calculated stock position of a biomass material in the EVOP value chain, covering physical, free, reserved and safely available quantities together with the safety margin and offer percentages applied.

value.description: Exact measured value, when a single figure is known.

minValue.description: Lower bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a minimum.

maxValue.description: Upper bound of the value, when the source declares a range or a maximum.

unitCode.description: Unit of measurement of the value, given as a UN/CEFACT code where one exists.

id.description: Property. Unique entity identifier, with the format urn:ngsi-ld:evop:biomass-inventory:<material>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be BiomassInventory

material.description: Property. Identifies the biomass material represented in the inventory, such as olive pits.

physicalStockKg.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Total physical quantity of the biomass currently recorded in stock.

freeStockKg.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Quantity of biomass available after accounting for quantities already committed or reserved.

safeAvailableKg.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Quantity of biomass considered safely available for offering or use after applying the defined safety margin.

advertisedQuantityKg.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Quantity of biomass from the inventory currently advertised or made available to other users.

reserveKg.description: Property. Expected unitCode: KGM. Quantity of biomass reserved and therefore excluded from the freely available stock.

safetyMarginPercent.description: Property. Expected unitCode: P1. Percentage of inventory retained as a safety margin to avoid committing the full physical stock.

offerPercentage.description: Property. Expected unitCode: P1. Percentage of the available inventory intended to be offered to other users.

movementCount.description: Property. Dimensionless. Number of stock movements recorded for the corresponding biomass inventory.

calculatedAt.description: Property. Date and time when the inventory values were last calculated or updated.
